chunks: Abdullah ibn Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us, he said: Abu Nasr Mansur ibn Abdullah ibn Ibrahim al-Isfahani narrated to us, he said: Ali ibn Abdullah narrated to us, he said: Dawud ibn Sulayman narrated to us, from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him), from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'There are four groups on whose behalf I will intercede on the Day of Resurrection, even if they were burdened with the sins of the people of the earth: the members of my Household; those who fulfill their needs when they are in need; those who love them with their heart and tongue; and those who defend them with their hand.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the four groups for whom the Prophet will intercede on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Saduq’s *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the fourfold criteria for prophetic intercession, emphasizing that love for the Ahl al-Bayt must be manifested through both internal conviction and external action, including material support and physical defense. It underscores the Shia concept of *Wilayah* as a comprehensive state of being that integrates belief, affection, and practical devotion, ensuring the Prophet’s intercession even for those burdened with significant sins.
